[Radiology Division | Amsterdam UMC (AMC) | 28 February 2025 | Study: Multiparametric MRI of the prostate]
Clinical context: Assessment of a recent PSA elevation to 4.3 and screening history, alongside a velocity of 0.32 ng/mL/yr.
Imaging findings: A 23.65 mL gland is noted on T2-weighted sequences. Within the left mid-gland peripheral zone, a 12 × 10 × 8 mm focal hypointensity is visualized. DWI demonstrates pronounced diffusion restriction with correspondingly low ADC values, while DCE shows early, focal enhancement compared to adjacent tissue. No seminal vesicle invasion or extraprostatic extension is evident, and pelvic lymph nodes appear normal.
IMPRESSION: A PI-RADS 4 focus occupies the left mid-gland peripheral zone. The 23.65 mL prostate volume corresponds to a PSA density of 0.182. The model estimates a csPCa probability of 0.7919737.
